$comment: vinext x bun compiled-exec quarantine ledger. Entries are RECLASSIFIED after each run (scripts/compat-vinext-ledger.mjs), never removed from the corpus: the denominator stays the node lane's. Founder constraints: at most 15 files, dated with at most 30 days to expiry, unsupported entries name the feature and link the upstream issue, flaky entries need mixed evidence. Each entry quarantines only its generated `cases` snapshot (refresh regenerates it from evidence runs); a snapshot case that stops failing reds the run, and a new failing case stays a real failure.
